description: This source file contains unit test cases for the ExistingVisitAssignmentHandler class within the OpenMRS API project. It tests the behavior of the handler when creating encounters, specifically focusing on whether existing visits are correctly assigned or not based on certain conditions.

classes.name: ExistingVisitAssignmentHandlerTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the behavior of ExistingVisitAssignmentHandler's methods related to encounter and visit assignment.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes test data from XML dataset before each test.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldAssignExistingVisitIfMatchFound
methods.description: Verifies that the handler assigns an existing visit to an encounter when a match is found.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldNotAssignVisitIfNoMatchFound
methods.description: Ensures that no visit is assigned if there is no matching visit for the encounter.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldNotAssignVisitWhichStoppedBeforeEncounterDate
methods.description: Checks that the visit is not assigned if its stop date is before the encounter date.
